meta.preheader: NIFTY 50 rose 1.14% to 25,514.30 as auto shares gained 4.40%; foreign investors bought ₹7,411 crore (provisional); US shares fell about 2% overnight.
meta.subject: Kubeerra Market Brief · Fri 20 Nov: NIFTY 50 rises 1.14% to 25,514.30; autos gain 4.40%

brief: The NIFTY 50 rose 1.14% to 25,514.30, its first close above 25,500 since February, and the Sensex 1.21% to 83,021.75 on Thursday; Nifty Bank rose 1.65% to a record 63,063 (Business Standard, Liquide).

Nifty Auto rose 4.40%, led by Maruti Suzuki, which Liquide linked to easing copper and aluminium prices; Nifty IT fell 1.10%, the only sector index lower. The NIFTY Midcap 100 rose 1.06% and the Smallcap 100 0.71% (DSIJ, Business Standard).
Foreign investors bought a net ₹7,411 crore and domestic institutions sold a net ₹1,357 crore (provisional, Kotak Neo). The rupee rose 9 paise to 93.32 per dollar, a fourth straight gain (PTI).
Overseas, the Dow fell 2.19%, the S&P 500 2.02% and the Nasdaq 2.25% on Thursday, as chip shares fell and Anthropic's first day of trading did not lift other AI stocks (Reuters).
IBJA had not published Thursday's rates when this issue was prepared; its latest, for Wednesday afternoon, put gold at ₹1,31,164 per 10 g. Spot gold fell about 1.5% on Thursday (IBJA, Reuters).

outlook.headline: Foreign buying, softer input costs and US rate expectations frame the week

drivers.title: Foreign buying
drivers.text: Foreign investors bought a net ₹7,411 crore on Thursday after ₹5,867 crore on Wednesday, and ₹1,01,641 crore from 1 to 19 November (provisional, Kotak Neo); HDFC Sky put November's foreign buying at a record $11.28 billion. Flows reach large-cap demand and the rupee.

drivers.title: Input costs
drivers.text: Kotak Neo linked Thursday's gains in auto shares to softer raw material prices, and in FMCG shares to expected relief on input costs; Upstox linked the rise in air-conditioner makers to copper at a seven-month low. Input prices reach company margins.

drivers.title: Crude and the rupee
drivers.text: Brent settled at $91.98 on Thursday (Bloomberg), and HDFC Sky said it had fallen about 21.6% in November. The rupee closed at 93.32 per dollar; Anuj Choudhary of Mirae Asset Sharekhan expects it to trade between 92.95 and 93.50 (PTI). Oil reaches India through the import bill, the rupee and fuel inflation.

global_cues.title: US shares and rate expectations
global_cues.text: The S&P 500 fell for a sixth straight session, and CME FedWatch showed a 96.4% chance of a quarter-point Fed rise in December (Reuters). US rates reach India through the dollar, the rupee and foreign flows into emerging markets; US technology sentiment reaches Indian IT shares.

global_cues.title: US yields and the dollar
global_cues.text: Treasury yields eased 1 to 3 basis points (Reuters), while the dollar stayed near a 19-month high (USAGOLD). A firm dollar weighs on the rupee and on metal prices.

us.text: All three main US indexes fell about 2%: the Dow lost more than 1,100 points and the S&P 500 fell for a sixth straight session (Reuters); energy and consumer staples were the only S&P sectors to edge higher (The Motley Fool).

us.title: Anthropic's debut and chip shares
us.text: Anthropic's IPO priced at $83 a share and opened at $111.50, with its first-day gain narrowing to about 17% by the close; Reuters said the debut did not lift wider AI shares, as AMD fell 7.7% and Nvidia 3.3%.

us.title: Company news
us.text: Palo Alto Networks rose about 6% after raising its 2027 revenue guidance, Walmart slipped 1% on its annual sales forecast and Williams-Sonoma fell about 15% (Reuters).

extras.label: Dollar index

events.title: December Fed rise priced in
events.text: After minutes of the October meeting pointed to further rises, CME FedWatch showed a 96.4% chance of a quarter-point rise in December (Reuters). The channel to India: the dollar, the rupee and foreign flows.

events.title: Hormuz shipping and fuel supply
events.text: Iran's navy reported tankers disabled by mines in the Strait of Hormuz (Reuters), while a meeting of the US president with his Chinese and Russian counterparts produced an agreement to raise global fuel supplies (Bloomberg). The channel to India: the import bill, fuel inflation and the rupee.

events.title: Other central banks
events.text: Reuters said the Bank of Japan's governor signalled a near-term rate rise, and Newsquawk reported ECB policymakers saying they were open to further rises. The channel to India: global yields and foreign flows into Indian debt.

commentary.text: USAGOLD said gold touched an overnight low of $3,693.54 on Thursday, a fresh 14-month low, after the minutes of the Fed's October meeting pointed to more rate rises.
Reuters reported a 96.4% chance of a quarter-point Fed rise in December, according to CME FedWatch; higher rates raise the cost of holding gold, which pays no interest.
USAGOLD said the dollar traded near a 19-month high, supported by a report that Washington was weighing new strikes on Iran.

category_explainer.text: AMFI's investor education page on SEBI's scheme categories describes a short duration fund as a debt scheme investing in debt and money market instruments such that the Macaulay duration of the portfolio is between one and three years. AMFI notes that the tenor of a fund's securities shapes its risk and return, and that funds holding securities with shorter tenors have lower risk and lower return. Each scheme's riskometer level and risk factors are set out in the fund house's own documents.

learn.title: What Macaulay duration measures
paragraphs: Macaulay duration is the weighted average time, in years, that it takes to recover the price paid for a bond through the present value of its expected cash flows: its interest payments and the repayment of principal (Tata Mutual Fund).

For a debt fund it is usually shorter than the fund's average maturity, zero-coupon bonds being the exception (Tata Mutual Fund). SEBI's categories use the portfolio's Macaulay duration: a short duration fund, for example, keeps it between one and three years (AMFI).

A fund with a higher Macaulay duration is more sensitive to changes in interest rates. A related measure, modified duration, approximates the percentage change in a fund's NAV for a one percentage point change in rates (Tata Mutual Fund).
